title: Tesseract Device Bridge setup
intro: Select a language to prepare an installation. No hardware will be started.
in_progress: Installation in progress. You can resume or cancel it.
pending: Core prepared. Import and publication will be available in subsequent stages.
abort: Cancel attempt and discard temporary files
stop: Press Ctrl+C in the terminal to stop. The attempt will be preserved for resumption.
error: Unable to update this attempt. Check its state and permissions before continuing.
phase_note: Data import, network settings and final activation will appear in subsequent wizard stages.
prepared: Empty ORM database prepared in temporary storage.
forbidden: Form rejected. Open the home page again at the same address and retry. Restarting the server invalidates previous sessions.
import_failed: Import failed. Review the selected source and its format.
devices_invalid: Device configuration is invalid. Review is required; no database was created.
file_rejected: An optional file was rejected and requires review.
entity_rejected: An entity was rejected and requires review.
legacy_validated: Legacy data validated in private staging.
sqlite_validated: SQLite data validated in private staging.
file_ignored: File not selected or not supported.
staging_only: Data is prepared in temporary storage. No physical output is activated.
processing: Processing. Wait until completion; do not close this page.
start_first: Select a language and click Continue to start.
import_intro: Import old files or a SQLite database. Review the inventory before writing to temporary storage.
server_paths: The path must exist on the computer running setup.
single_mapping: Explicit destination for a single file
upload_hint: YAML/JSON: up to 8 MiB per file and 32 MiB total. SQLite: up to 256 MiB. For receita.json, select its public or private destination. Successive uploads add files to the inventory; duplicate destinations are rejected. Select a new source to start over.
preview_large: File too large for preview. It may still be imported within its format limits.
preview_invalid: Unable to parse preview. Raw content will not be displayed.
preview_truncated: Preview limited to 64 KiB, with credentials redacted.
allow_partial: Allow partial import and preserve review requirements
import_options_hint: Import writes only to staging. It does not publish .env or authorize hardware.
review_hint: Acknowledgement records review. Outstanding issues remain; physical operation stays unauthorized.
abort_confirm: Cancel this attempt and remove only setup-owned temporary files?
select_required: Select at least one supported file.
infra_intro: Configure the panel address and ports. Configuration is prepared in a private .env copy.
infra_configured: Use the backend configured in the database
infra_mode_hint: Simulation forces a simulated backend, disables MQTT and uses 127.0.0.1 with the test port. Disabling simulation neither changes the stored backend nor completes setup.
infra_test_hint: Used only with SIMULATION_ONLY=1. Must not conflict with setup or another service.
infra_host_hint: IP or hostname without http:// or a path. 127.0.0.1 limits access locally; 0.0.0.0 listens on IPv4 interfaces. Ignored in simulation. Authentication policy is configured in the next stage.
infra_port_hint: Used with SIMULATION_ONLY=0; ignored in simulation.
infra_db_hint: Generated relative to the new clone root. No final file is created or overwritten yet; candidate selection and publication happen during completion.
infra_not_active: This stage does not change the active .env, publish the database or enable GPIO. Valid setup completion will gate configured ORM operation.
infra_port_available: Effective port available at the time of checking.
infra_port_unchecked: Non-local or named host: verify port availability at the destination.
infra_invalid_port: Ports must be integers between 1 and 65535.
infra_invalid_host: Enter a valid IP or hostname without a URL or configuration characters.
infra_port_busy: Effective port is occupied, reserved or unavailable. Select another port.
infra_env_invalid: Unable to safely prepare the local .env. Review its format, permissions and links.
infra_start_first: Start an installation attempt before configuring infrastructure.
security_intro: Choose how to protect panel administration. The credential is prepared in the attempt's private .env.
security_custom_hint: Any non-empty value is accepted, including short values. Weak values receive a warning. Only incompatible control characters and sizes above 4096 bytes are rejected.
security_local_ack: I confirm that administration without a token will be restricted to local access.
security_local_policy: No token: panel binds to 127.0.0.1, remote administration is blocked, and origin validation plus CSRF are mandatory. Use an SSH tunnel for a Raspberry. Physical safeguards remain active.
security_once: Copy it now. The token is displayed once and is not stored in the browser cookie. Generate another if it is lost.
security_weak: The custom token is short. It was accepted, but a longer unpredictable value is recommended.
security_staging: Active configuration remains intact. Publication and release after valid completion belong to the next stage.
security_start_first: Start an installation attempt before configuring credentials.
security_infra_first: Prepare infrastructure first. Changing infrastructure requires preparing credentials again.
security_invalid_token: Enter a non-empty token up to 4096 bytes without newline or null characters.
security_confirm_local: Confirm local-only access before proceeding without a token.
finish_intro: Select the prepared database and confirm publication. The final database must not exist. Replacing an existing .env requires explicit confirmation and a private backup.
finish_recovery_hint: Publication is incomplete. Runtime remains blocked. Resume this attempt or roll back only its published files.
finish_rollback_hint: Restore the previous .env and remove only the database owned by this incomplete publication?
finish_not_started: Setup completed. No runtime or hardware was started. Close the wizard and start manually when ready.
finish_empty: No devices: the launch command opens administrative configuration only, without GPIO/MQTT.
finish_review: Outstanding issues remain. Simulation was forced and physical operation remains blocked.
finish_service_hint: Generation does not install, enable or start the service. Each privileged action requires a separate terminal command.
finish_service_commands: Run only the actions you authorize, in order:
finish_no_service: Automatic service unavailable on this platform or while review is pending. Use manual execution.
finish_closed: Wizard stopped. You may close this window. To start: python run_bridge.py
finish_replace_env: I authorize replacing this new installation's .env, preserving a private backup.
finish_authorize: I authorize completion in configured mode, including a valid selected physical backend.
finish_confirm: I reviewed and confirm publication of this installation.
finish_safety: Publication does not start hardware. Pending or empty installations stay simulated. Existing interlocks remain active.
publish_invalid: Unable to validate publication. Review candidates and integrity.
publish_prepare_first: Prepare a database candidate, infrastructure and credential before completion.
publish_env_changed: .env changed since preparation. Review infrastructure and credentials again.
publish_replace_env: Explicitly confirm replacement of the existing .env.
publish_existing: Destination exists or changed. No database will be overwritten; review recovery.
publish_authorize: Confirm configured-mode authorization or select simulation.
publish_rollback_final: A completed installation cannot be undone by cancelling setup.
finish_maintenance_hint: After fixing devices or review items in the simulated panel, review configuration and revalidate here. Configured mode requires an updated .env and the authorization below. The wizard never starts hardware.
finish_review_confirm: I confirm outstanding issues were corrected and reviewed this installation.
publish_python: The real backend requires the validated Python 3.9 GPIO environment on Raspberry. Use simulation here or complete setup on the target hardware.
folder_help: Paste a path or use the folder selector. Choose the old installation root containing devices.yml or the data folder; do not select data by itself. For files on the browser computer, use browser upload.
folder_navigation: Click a folder to navigate, then choose Use this folder.
folder_no_children: No visible subfolders. Use this folder or paste another path.
folder_truncated: Limited list. Paste a more specific path to reach other folders.
folder_unavailable: Could not open this folder. Check its path and the setup user permissions.
inventory_filter: Only file names and paths recognized by migration are listed. Documentation, code, .env and unrelated files are excluded from the grid and are not imported.
inventory_empty: No recognized files in this folder. Select the old installation root or upload compatible files.
devices_empty: devices.yml contains no devices. For an empty installation, cancel this attempt and start without data; partial import does not create devices.
devices_remote_invalid: Remote control is enabled without state_topic. Fix a copy with a real topic or explicitly disable hardware.remote_control in that copy.
devices_required: A device is missing required id, name, role or hardware fields. Review a copy of devices.yml.
devices_object_required: devices.yml must contain a YAML object with a devices list.
devices_yaml_invalid: Invalid YAML syntax in devices.yml. Review indentation and structure in a copy.
abort_files_busy: Temporary files could not all be removed. Close programs using them and retry cancellation. Attempt state was preserved.
abort_publication_exists: A publication receipt exists. Use recovery or rollback on the completion page before cancelling.
unsupported: Not importable: invalid schema, database in use or incompatible format
